prontera,164,154,3	script	Mall	10078,{

OnMallCommand:
if ( getmapflag( strcharinfo(3),mf_pvp ) ) || getmapflag( strcharinfo(3),mf_gvg ) { //restrict on pvp and gvg map
	dispbottom .@atcmd_command$+" failed in PVP/GVG maps";
	end;
}else

switch(select("~ Sell Items", "~ Armors", "~ Weapons", "~ Ammunition", "~ Etc")){
	case 1:
		callshop "Seller",2;
		end;

	case 2: //Armors
		switch(select("~ Armor", "~ Garment", "~ Footgear", "~ Shield", "~ Accessories")){
			case 1:
				callshop "Armor",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 2:
				callshop "Garments",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 3:
				callshop "Footgear",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 4:
				callshop "Shield",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 5:
				callshop "Accessories",1;
				end;
			break;
		}
	
	case 3: //Weapons
		switch(select("~ Mace", "~ Knuckle" , "~ Whips" , "~ Instrument" , "~ Books" , "~ Guns" , "~ Fuuma Shuriken" , "~ One-Handed Swords" , "~ Two-Handed Swords" , "~ Spears" , "~ Dagger" , "~ Axes" , "~ Bows" , "~ Staff / Rods" , "~ Katars")){
			case 1:
				callshop "Mace",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 2:
				callshop "Knuckle",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 3:
				callshop "Whips",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 4:
				callshop "Instruments",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 5:
				callshop "Books",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 6:
				callshop "Guns",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 7:
				callshop "Fuuma Shuriken",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 8:
				callshop "One-Handed Swords",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 9:
				callshop "Two-Handed Swords",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 10:
				callshop "Spears",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 11:
				callshop "Dagger",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 12:
				callshop "Axes",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 13:
				callshop "Bows",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 14:
				callshop "Staffs / Rods",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 15:
				callshop "Katars",1;
				end;
			break;
		}

	case 4: //Ammunition
		case 8:
			callshop "Ammunition",1;
			end;
		break;

	case 5: //Etc
		switch(select("~ Alchemist Dealer", "~ Blacksmith Dealer", "~ Street Dealer", "~ Talisman Dealer", "~ Sheepy Gonzales")){
			case 1:
				callshop "Alchemist Dealer",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 2:
				callshop "Blacksmith Dealer",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 3:
				callshop "Street Dealer",1;
				end;
			break;

			case 4:
				callshop "Talisman NPC",1;
				end;

			case 5:
				callshop "Sheepy Gonzales",1;
				end;
			break;
		}
}

OnInit:
	bindatcmd "mall",strnpcinfo(3)+"::OnMallCommand";
	end;
}
